title: aspris capillaris
intro: Aspris capillaris, commonly known as Horse Tail or Equisetum, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to stimulate digestion, improve circulation, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Aspris capillaris include its antiseptic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as asthma and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Aspris capillaris include flavonoids, saponins, and lignans, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
